## Substack

I also write essays and articles at the intersection of physics, philosophy, and science communication. These pieces are deliberately less rigorous than my academic research: they explore ideas, interpretations, and the broader questions that sit around physics, from the meaning of mathematical descriptions to the limits of how we observe the universe.
